views.markdown:
Prevents notification sounds from lowering now-playing audio. During playback, notification volume follows media volume.
 Tested on iPhone 8 Plus (iOS 16.6, Dopamine RootHide via conversion) and iPhone 11 Pro Max (iOS 26.0.1, Dopamine 3 RootHide).

Installable on iOS 16.0 and later. Tested on iPhone 8 Plus with iOS 16.6 and Dopamine RootHide using the earlier converted package. The native build was tested on iPhone 11 Pro Max with iOS 26.0.1 and Dopamine 3 RootHide.

Rootless and native RootHide. Native RootHide installs directly without Patcher.

- Renamed NeverLowerMusic16 to Never Lower Music.
- Opens installation to iOS 16.0 and later. Includes separate rootless and native RootHide packages.
